steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Ah! Granny! Stop, there's a filthy, man-eating presence ahead! It's very dangerous!

You arrive at the alley to find an old woman holding a strange device about to enter the dangerous area in the prophecy. With her impressive agility, Yanyan bursts into action and rushes over to pull her back!

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: Oh my, what's happening?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Excuse us, but we'd advise you not to go any further, ma'am. You may fall.
That filthy, man-eating presence indeed exists. But it's just an open sewer. Even Yanyan can't find any other danger beyond that with her persistent search.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: It seems Yanyan's prophecy was inaccurate again... I'm relieved there's no real danger, but how can I go on being a seer like this...
After the series of failed prophecies, it seems that Yanyan pinned all her hopes on this prophecy about the evil spirit, but it still didn't come true.

Perhaps that's why although the girl is relieved to find no real evil spirit, her face still seems dejected and frustrated. Just as you make to speak up and comfort her, the old woman standing by suddenly smiles and takes her hand.

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: Though I don't understand a single word, if you hadn't pulled me back, these old bones of mine would have been struggling in pain down the sewer right now.

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: Thank you, sweetheart. It's all thanks to you I'm still standing here!
The stranger's gratitude dispels the gloom on Yanyan's face and shifts her attention away from the failed prophecy for the first time. She looks up at the kind old lady, revealing a shy smile.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Don't mention it. It's nothing!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: What are all these things you have with you? This one in your hand, is it an iron? Why does it glow? What's it for?

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: Oh, these? They're equipment for finding aliens. I think this one's called... oh, a peripheral biological detector. It beeps to alert me when it detects the creature I've specified.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Aliens? Do they really exist in this world? Where do they appear? Are you here to research about them? Can you communicate with them?

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: Of course, child. Look, this scarf I'm wearing is my interpreter. It's carrying so many languages in it. Once I find the aliens, surely we can have a conversation.
This strange old woman is covered in weird gadgets and speaks pure nonsense. Yet, for some reason, you can't bring yourself to be wary of her.

Perhaps it's because of her attitude toward Yanyan. She patiently answers every childish question, watching the girl with an attentive and kind gaze. It's clear she is genuinely fond of the child in front of her.
While you are analyzing this strange old woman, Yanyan's attention is captured by yet another new find on the old woman's wrist.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: You must have been wearing this bracelet for a long time, right? My grandma says that a trinket develops a spirit when worn over time and can protect its owner!
Taken aback, the old woman instinctively caresses the old bracelet with her fingertips as if it were her treasure.

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: Yes, it's a gift from my daughter. She made it when she was little. I've worn it for a long time...

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: I can relate. My grandma also made me a talisman, which I treat very carefully when I wear it!
Yanyan pulls out the talisman hanging around her neck enthusiastically, showing it off to the old woman and you.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Grandma says this talisman is imbued with her wish, and it'll grant me whatever I desire! I wonder what wish is imbued on your bracelet... It must be for safety or health, right? That's why I was able to save you in time!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: But why did you come to a place like this, Granny? Even without the filthy presence from Yanyan's prophecy, it's so dark and unpleasant here! Do aliens like this kind of environment?

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: What a smart girl. Yes, I came here looking for aliens indeed. Unfortunately, it looks like another miss... I'll have to check another place next.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Another place? Do you know of other places where there might be aliens? Where?

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: Yes, it's the legendary wishing tree. Everyone says it's very effective, so I think there must be many aliens around. Maybe my old bones will have some luck there.

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: If it piques your interest, why not come along? Take a walk with me and keep me company, how about it?

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Yanyan wants to go!
Yanyan's eyes light up. She turns to you, pleading with puppy-like eyes.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Alright, we'll go together.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Yay! Off we go! I can't wait to meet the aliens!
Honestly, it's hard to say no to those eyes. And this trip could be beneficial if it helps her escape from her self-pity.
So you patiently accompany the duo to the next location mentioned by the old woman.

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: Look at all these reports of alien sightings I've gathered here. Crop circles in the suburbs, mysterious signals received by the radio station at 3 a.m., and wreckage of unidentified flying objects... You name it!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: So the radio station doesn't just receive messages from the dead at 3 a.m., but audio notes by aliens too!

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: You're right, sweetheart. Look, this black crystal was dug out from a ruin. No analysis has been able to find out what it is. If you ask me, it must be a product of alien technology, like a fragment of a spacecraft, that sort of thing.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Hmm, let me take a closer look with my magnifying glass... Grandma has taught me that this kind of wavy pattern often indicates the existence of an old marine civilization! Maybe the aliens came looking for water!

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: I think so too, which is why I've been looking for them for so many years. I believe that as long as I keep searching, I'll figure out the aliens' purpose and trace them.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Exactly! I also believe that as long as I work hard enough, I will once again receive the blessings and guidance of the gods and become a worthy seer!

It's impressive how the two can stay on the same wavelength while they are essentially talking about completely different things. Perhaps this is what the Eastians like to call a serendipitous encounter.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Hehe, you're such a great storyteller, Granny. Yanyan used to love listening to tales too!

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: Oh? What kind of tales? I'd love to hear them too!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Let me see... Got it! Once, Grandma told me a tale called the Magical Deer and the Rainbow Herb!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: It's about a magical deer that lives in the forest. After being tricked by greedy humans once, it is heartbroken and takes the life-saving rainbow herb to hide deep in the forest, never seen by anyone again!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: In the end, a seer wearing a leaf-woven skirt worships her way into the forest and prays to it. After that, the magical deer finally reappear with the rainbow herb in their mouths!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Ever since Grandma had first told me this story, Yanyan always wanted to become a seer, to protect everyone!

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: Oh, what a wonderful story. I also believe that the trees, plants, and animals in the forest possess great spiritual power and can help everyone. Just like this wishing tree.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Is this the one? Have we found it? Eh, why is the bark of this tree all black?
You all stop in your tracks and look up, sizing up this legendary wishing tree.
Just as Yanyan said, one half of this tree, towering in the middle of the road like a landmark, is completely black. It is also covered in wish notes, making it look rather odd.

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: I've heard that this tree has been modified by aliens. The black substance on the bark is the trace left by those beings. That's why it can fulfill the wishes people hang on it...

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Wow, that sounds awesome! Let me climb up to see if the aliens are living on top of the tree and peeking at everyone's wish note!
Before you realize, Yanyan has already climbed up the tall wishing tree, moving from one branch to another with agile movements.
While she's searching attentively, you also get tasked with the important job of waving the electric iron, diligently looking for signals sent by aliens under the tree.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Ah, look over there. There's a strange mark. Maybe it's a code left by the aliens!

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: Careful, sweetheart! Hold on tight and be safe!

Like a kind grandmother caring for her grandchild, the old lady not only reminds Yanyan earnestly, but also stands under the tree with her arms open and follows Yanyan's movements, ready to catch her at any moment.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Don't worry, I'm an excellent tree climber, I won't fall! Let me see what this is... Oh no, it's bird poop!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: What a shame! ${PlayerName}, Granny, move aside, Yanyan is coming down!
Yanyan indeed moves nimbly down the tree, but noticing she's sweating profusely from all the climbing, the old lady still takes out several handkerchiefs and wipes the sweat off her caringly.

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: You must be exhausted, aren't you? Look at all that sweat. Close your eyes, sweetheart, let me clean your face.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Eh? The handkerchief smells nice. It reminds me of something...

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: There, now you're a clean and pretty girl again... Why are you staring at my handkerchief? Don't you like the scent?

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: It's nothing! Um, I just got this idea. We can ask the people living nearby! They must be able to give us more clues!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Let's hope so...
Eager to test out her idea, Yanyan stands at the corner looking around for a while, then quickly catches a middle-aged man passing by with a shopping bag.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Sir, do you live near the wishing tree? Do you know about the aliens living on it? We're here to hang out with them. Do you know how we can find them?

steps.speaker: Passerby
steps.content: Aliens? All we have here is a tree that survived a lightning strike. I suppose many like to call it the wishing tree, but that's all nonsense! Never heard anything about aliens either!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Really? Hmm, I'm a little skeptical! Could it be that everyone else is just keeping that secret from you?

steps.speaker: Passerby
steps.content: What are you...
At a loss for words, the passerby shifts his gaze toward you and the old lady who seem to be Yanyan's guardians. You can only force a smile and go over, trying to smooth things over.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Excuse us. She's a bit stubborn... My apologies for taking up your time. I'll have a word with her when we get back.
While you are reassuring the passerby, Yanyan has already quickly found her next target and started a new round of inquiry.
Having just sent the man off, you make to stop her but are stopped by the old lady, who is smiling indulgently.

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: Look at how happy she is. Let's not dampen her spirits. It's not like it's causing any harm.
You glance at Yanyan with her lively motions and bright expressions, her vibrant energy in stark contrast to her previously downcast demeanor. You swallow the words of objection.
You and the old lady end up watching her bustling around for a while before returning empty-handed in the end.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Why won't anyone admit there are aliens here? Is this the hardship one must go through in pursuit of miracles, according to Grandma?

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Yanyan wants to keep going, but my stomach is growling...

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: Come and sit down. You must be exhausted after all that effort, right? Let's eat something first.
The old lady seats you down under the tree and takes out several portions of food from her huge backpack, distributing them to you.
After thanking her, Yanyan picks up one of the pies and takes a bite ravenously. Her eyes immediately light up.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: A beef pie! Although it's different from the crispy one Grandma makes, it's so delicious!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: How strange... It tastes so nostalgic! Granny, is this your secret recipe?

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: Oh, it's nothing special. My daughter used to love this pie too. She would get the filling all around her mouth, burying her face into it... So I spent some time perfecting it...

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Does your daughter not like it anymore? But it's so tasty.
This time, the old lady doesn't answer her question, simply patting her head.

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: Take your time to enjoy the food. I'll go and have a look at this tree. Yanyan, eat as much as you want. I've made more than enough, alright?
Yanyan nods emphatically and sees the old lady off, holding the same posture when she got the head pats. After the woman disappears, she turns to you and smiles sheepishly with her greasy lips.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: ${PlayerName}, do you want more? If not, can Yanyan have it? Hehe, thank you!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Actually, I was quite sickly when I was little. Once, I had a high fever and insisted on having Grandma's beef pie.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: It was raining heavily that day, and the roads were dreadful. But Grandma still went all the way to buy the freshest beef and made me some steaming hot pies.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Later, when I became the new seer and told Grandma the news, she was overjoyed. She hugged me exuberantly, laughing and crying at the same time.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: She said I was the greatest pride of her life and made me a whole table of beef pies, each filled to the brim.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: I ate so much that I ended up with a stomachache in the middle of the night. You should see Grandma's face when she found out!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: But every time I think back, I still feel so happy, and I still adore the beef pies. To me, that's the taste of a wish come true.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Maybe I find the taste of this pie particularly nostalgic because, for Granny's daughter, it was also a pie of happiness that tasted like a fulfilled wish!
Holding a beef pie, Yanyan looks up at the wishing tree. Countless notes heavy with wishes hang on the branches, rustling in the wind like murmured prayers.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: ${PlayerName}, if you happen to have a coin, could I borrow it to make a wish?
You rummage through your pockets to find a forgotten coin and hand it to Yanyan. The girl closes her eyes to make a wish, then skillfully tosses the coin under the tree.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: What wish did you make?

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Hehe, according to Eastian customs, you should never tell others your wishes, or they won't come true!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: By the way, where has Granny gone? Maybe she's waiting for us. Let's go find her!
You look around and finally find the old woman behind the tree.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: There you are! Granny, what are you doing here? Is it about the aliens...
Yanyan's cheerful greeting stops abruptly. Bewildered at the old woman wiping her tears under the tree, she steps closer to you nervously and tugs at your sleeve.
But you are equally confused about the reason she's crying, and you don't feel entitled to pry into her private matters.
Finally, Yanyan breaks the silence and approaches her cautiously.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Granny, what's wrong? Are you sad because you couldn't find the aliens?

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Don't worry, Yanyan will help you. Together we can surely...

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: Yanyan, my dear child, don't worry. I'm fine.
The old woman clasps Yanyan's warm hand, as if to comfort her and also to gain some strength from her.
After a moment, she composes herself and splays the hand she used to wipe her tears. In her palm lies a wish note blown down by the wind. The handwriting is childish, and the wish is an innocent one.
[I wish Mommy could be with me on my birthday.]

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: I'm fine, really. It's just that, seeing the wish on this note reminded me of my daughter, so...

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: So I got a bit sad.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Granny, your daughter, did she...
With everything that's happened, even the usually cheerful Yanyan senses something is wrong. She moves closer to the old woman, wanting to offer some comfort.

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: Yes, my daughter has been gone for a long time. And not a day goes by I don't miss her...

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: I was always busy working and rarely had time to be with my daughter. I only made her favorite beef pies once in a while. Thankfully, she was very understanding and never complained. Looking back, she took care of me more than I did her.
She raises her hand to touch Yanyan's worried face, her tone gentle, as if recalling a story that happened to someone else.

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: That year, I asked her what gift she wanted for her birthday. I thought she'd ask for her favorite beef pies, but she said nothing. Instead, she gave me a handmade bracelet.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Grandma has said that Yanyan's birthday also marks the day of my mother's suffering. Your daughter must have known how much you sacrificed for her. That's why she did that!

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: Yes... Just like you said, she was always so considerate. In that way, she was a lot like you.

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: Even when it came to her birthday wish. She said she just wanted me to grant her a simple wish and not to bother to prepare anything. But she never got to tell me that wish, for before that, she left me for good due to an accident.

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: I couldn't accept her departure, nor could I accept that I couldn't even guess her wish. It wasn't until I started sorting through her belongings that I found she had collected many alien magazines, and her diary even mentioned...
The old woman lets go of Yanyan and pulls out a worn diary from her pocket. Her fingers tremble as she flips to a certain page.
[Are aliens real? How I wish to find out!]

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: I guess, maybe that was her unspoken wish?

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: Did the injury teach you nothing?

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: That's the only thing I can do for her now...
The old woman's tone is extremely firm. She turns and gently strokes the wishing tree's charred bark, her touch so tender, as if a delicate wish is imprinted on it.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: No wonder you've always felt familiar to me... Now I know why. It's because you remind me of Grandma...

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: The talisman, the perfumed handkerchiefs, always worrying about Yanyan getting hurt, and the beef pies... Even your search for aliens...
She sounds a bit dazed. You lower your head to look at Yanyan and find her staring at the old woman with a stunned expression and wet eyes, obviously harboring something in her heart.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Yanyan is so moved by Granny's story. Yanyan can't stand to watch her suffer... ${PlayerName}, I want to help her fulfill her wish.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: But, but Yanyan's power is unstable right now. I might not be of much use. I may even end up doing something stupid again...
Her small face crinkles like a steamed bun, that hearty, delicious Eastian snack.
Her hesitation is visible, and even more so is the determination it takes for her to make this decision after much deliberation.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: But Yanyan still wants to help Granny. I'll help her figure out what her daughter's last wish really was!
You smile and can't resist patting her head. The girl's body is comfortingly warm, just like her sincere heart.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: If that's what you want, go for it, Yanyan. Not for duty and not to prove yourself... but because you truly believe that wishes can come true, and you want them to come true.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Yes! I'll do my best!
